name: Antto Väätäinen
headline: UI Technical Artist · UI/UX
summary: UI Technical Artist with 9+ years of experience specializing in UX/UI design, interaction design, and UI programming across AAA console, PC, and mobile games. I bridge design and engineering to deliver production-ready interfaces, with additional strengths in shaders, UI animation, and VFX.

projects.name: Field Day
projects.description: Worked on Field Day as a UI Technical Artist.
highlights: Implemented UI and created UI assets.
Designed UX flows and UI systems.
Optimized and scaled UI across devices.

projects.name: Ultimate Survivors
projects.description: Helped implement new UI features for the live game.
highlights: Reworked the shop visuals, giving the store a facelift.
Implemented the Chain Offers and Hero Trigger Offers UI.
Helped split and manage addressables to improve loading times.

projects.name: Pax Dei
highlights: Created widgets in Unreal Engine and built UI layouts.
Contributed to UI and UX design.

projects.name: Saros
projects.description: Supported Saros during pre-production at Housemarque.
highlights: Documented UX/UI decisions for Photo Mode, the minimap, and other features, drawing on experience from Returnal.
Researched new approaches to creating UI materials and shaders in Unreal Engine 5.

projects.name: Returnal
projects.description: Housemarque’s third-person roguelite shooter for PS5.
highlights: Worked on UI-related shaders and materials for the HUD, minimap visualization, and in-world holograms.
Created Photo Mode filters and effects.

projects.name: Blade Runner Rogue
projects.description: Contributed to the official mobile game based on the Blade Runner universe.
highlights: Implemented art assets and created tools to automate and streamline production.
Worked on UI implementation and animation, VFX, shaders, and performance optimization.

paragraphs: Working on Field Day, the latest game from Clash of Clans’ former Creative Director.

Turned concepts into production-ready game UI, owning layout, implementation, animation, and VFX. Built the UI systems in C# and rebuilt the UI framework from the ground up to support soft launch and future development.

Freelance UI Technical Artist on Ultimate Survivors during its soft launch and preparation for global launch. Supported UI implementation in Unity, including layouts, animation, VFX, and view model setup.

Collaborated on three game prototypes during Supercell’s Spark Program, developing each concept over a three-to-four-week cycle. Worked on UX and UI design, taking prototypes from initial design through full in-game implementation.
Worked on Pax Dei, an open-world sandbox MMORPG. Implemented UI features in Unreal Engine and contributed to UX design.
Worked on Returnal, the BAFTA-winning PS5 game. Key contributions included Photo Mode, the minimap, and UI VFX.
Also supported Saros during pre-production, helping establish foundations and carry forward learnings from Returnal.
Worked on Blade Runner: Rogue, a mobile character-collection RPG based on the Blade Runner IP. The game soft-launched and later relaunched during my time at the studio.
